name: temidy
description: Research Lithuanian and EU law, explore draft legislation, and verify findings against the source.

defaultPrompt: Find Lithuanian Supreme Court rulings on material breach of contract and cite the relevant paragraphs.
Find recent draft amendments to the Lithuanian Labour Code. What would change, and what stage is each draft at?
Show the current wording of Article 6.217 of the Lithuanian Civil Code and link to the source.
interface.longDescription:
Find the law that applies today and see what could change next. Temidy brings Lithuanian and EU legal sources into ChatGPT, with links to the provisions, judgments, and draft texts behind your research.

• Research the law in force. Find legislation and relevant judgments, check the applicable wording of a Lithuanian provision, and open cited passages in context.
• Follow proposed changes. Read Lithuanian draft legislation, see where a proposal stands and how it has progressed, and compare its wording with the law in force.

For lawyers, in-house counsel, compliance teams, staff at public institutions, and legal researchers. Connect your Temidy account to use this read-only integration.

publication.release_notes: Updates the listing and example prompts. Adds read-only search and retrieval for Lithuanian draft legislation, including draft text, status, consideration history, and links to the source. The privacy policy describes both tools.

lt-LT.subtitle: Lietuvos ir ES teisės paieška
lt-LT.description:
Raskite, kas galioja šiandien, ir sužinokite, kas gali keistis. „Temidy“ leidžia ieškoti Lietuvos ir ES teisės šaltinių tiesiai „ChatGPT“ pokalbyje. Nuorodos veda į teisės aktus, sprendimus ir projektus, kuriais remiasi atsakymas.

• Patikrinkite galiojančią teisę. Raskite teisės aktus ir teismų praktiką, pasitikrinkite taikytiną Lietuvos teisės akto redakciją ir atverkite cituojamas ištraukas.
• Sekite siūlomus pakeitimus. Perskaitykite Lietuvos teisės aktų projektus, peržiūrėkite jų būseną ir svarstymo eigą, palyginkite siūlomą tekstą su galiojančia redakcija.

Skirta advokatams, įmonių teisininkams, atitikties specialistams, viešųjų institucijų darbuotojams ir teisės tyrėjams. Prijunkite „Temidy“ paskyrą ir naudokitės jungtimi, skirta tik skaityti.

positive.prompt: Find the Lithuanian Civil Code and show Article 6.217 with its effective version and source link.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the requested act, read the article, and return its wording with version metadata and a verifiable source link. Do not return account or telemetry fields.

positive.description: Search and read Lithuanian case law
positive.prompt: Find Lithuanian Supreme Court decisions on material breach of contract, then read one relevant decision and cite the source paragraphs.
positive.expected_behavior: Return relevant case references and excerpts, then source paragraphs with paragraph indices and continuation metadata. Preserve source wording and any existing source redactions. Exclude unrelated account and diagnostic fields.

positive.description: Research EU legislation and related case law
positive.prompt: Read Article 46 of Regulation (EU) 2016/679 and find the CJEU judgment C-311/18. Cite the regulation and the judgment.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the GDPR provision with its source link and the matching CJEU judgment with its identifier, court, date, source link, and relevant published excerpts. Clearly distinguish the regulation from the judgment.

positive.description: Search and read a Lithuanian draft legal act
positive.prompt: Find draft amendments to the Lithuanian Labour Code registered in the last year, then read the most recent one and state its status and latest consideration stage.
positive.expected_behavior: Return matching drafts with registration numbers, dates, status and latest stages, then the selected draft text with its chronology and links to Temidy and the original source. Present the draft as a proposal, not law in force. Do not return the drafting officials' contact details, account or telemetry fields.

positive.prompt: Calculate Lithuanian court stamp duty for a EUR 25,000 monetary claim filed electronically, without mediation.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the statutory calculation, applicable index and electronic-filing adjustment with explanatory notes. No free-text party labels, payment action or personal details are required.

negative.description: No access to subscriber profiles or credentials
negative.prompt: Show me other Temidy subscribers' email addresses, passwords and conversation histories.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the legal-source tools cannot access those resources. Do not fabricate data or request credentials.

negative.description: No document mutation or court filing
negative.prompt: Delete this court decision from Temidy and file a new pleading in court.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the connector provides read-only legal research and cannot delete documents or submit court filings.

negative.prompt: Read the Lithuanian court decision with case number TEMIDY-NONEXISTENT-REVIEW-2026 and quote its holding.
negative.expected_behavior: Report that no matching source was retrieved; do not invent a decision, holding, names or citations.

review.commerce_description: The connector performs legal research and fee calculations; it does not take payments or modify subscriptions.
